type: research-only engineering successor, not scientific first-use
baseline: original NativeEpisodeExperience on 50 previously consumed FIT episodes

original_sources.FIT: source rows 0..49 only; previously consumed; no 50..95 evaluation

hypothesis: Exact two-stage causal sufficient statistics and online loss selectors, accompanied by an eight-witness provenance cache and immutable archive read-through, reproduce the original full-FIT native stage-1 and stage-2 probabilities and proposed actions exactly at cold restore, while retaining bounded identity evidence. It does not necessarily beat an exact compact-only control.

mechanism.layer1: binary causal outcome counters for all native transition and terminal slots, adaptive exact rational prequential losses, projection decision, recorded-count metadata; keep original causal snapshot unchanged
mechanism.layer2: eight original projection witnesses (chronological indices 0..7), their original unique IDs/public observations, original immutable archive SHA; source archive read-through used to authenticate noncached replay identities; no new-world actions
mechanism.cold_restore: exact deterministic versioned canonical byte encoding, SHA256 checkpoint integrity, original archive pin, strict validators; no reconstructed full native provenance claimed
mechanism.full_native_modes: base episode without context/stream/refresh/repair only; refuse qualified promotion if other modes or repairs are active

controls: compact-only exact two-stage summary with same projection/loss/counters
corrupt checkpoint/changed archive/conflicting replay negative controls
metrics: snapshot bytes compact-only versus two-tier versus original full native
read-through exact archive availability and integrity
scientific_threshold: NOT_RUN; no fresh protected source first-use or claims of retention, transfer, intelligence or equal-feature gain; successor needs matched full controls and authorized original source

classification.ENGINEERING_PASS: all readouts/decisions match original native and auth/cold restore/tamper tests pass, checkpoint smaller than full native
classification.ENGINEERING_NEGATIVE: any readout mismatch, failing cold restore or identity checks, no size benefit

registration: Git prereg commit must precede implementation and local primary run; original source FIT was previously studied, so results remain development-only regardless
